verdict.rationale: Vanta's first-party docs say it combs your knowledge base of security documentation and previous questionnaires to generate responses for new questionnaires. Its agentic workflows automate questionnaires end to end, leaving you to review, approve, and submit, which matches the drafts-I-review model. The Vanta AI Agent completes questionnaires, and API endpoints manage Customer Trust questionnaire responses. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that answers draw on live control and test data (not just docs and past answers), documentation of supported questionnaire formats such as spreadsheet uploads, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
